title: The Decision Review After Ninety Days
short_teaser: A planned review date prevents a decision from becoming permanent by neglect.
story: A planned review date prevents a decision from becoming permanent by neglect. The team can evaluate evidence without reopening the issue every day. A decision can be firm now and still include a responsible moment for reconsideration. Strategy is choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: A decision can be firm now and still include a responsible moment for reconsideration. Strategy is choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change.
spark_application: Identify the decision underneath your current activity. Choose the smallest next move that would create useful information. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
